name: Mikage Yuuki
source:
She is a physical education teacher at Seishin Academy and advises the track and field team. She has a strong temperament and takes pride in not being outdone by men, and she is not pleased with the sexual coaching that the protagonist, [url=/c133970]Hajime Tanaka[/url], is doing.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/saiminseishidou/character_page01.html]official site[/url]]
